source_inspection.label: SOURCE-DERIVED
source_inspection.observation: The reference was reduced to an authenticated DesignCase, observation record and observe-only captures; proprietary source assets and hidden implementation were not transferred into the candidate workspace.
source_inspection.quality_loss: Exact source geometry, font metrics and artwork detail are intentionally unavailable to the implementation.
source_inspection.why: The study must preserve the reference boundary and test grammar transfer rather than reproduce protected material.
source_inspection.possible_remediation: Keep future visual comparisons at the principle and evidence level; do not recover or import protected source assets.

retrieval.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
retrieval.observation: V1 and V2 retrieval receipts resolve the same authenticated DesignCase and three rights-authorized principle sources used to frame typography, motion and editorial comparison.
retrieval.quality_loss: No source recipe, implementation dependency or proprietary asset is available to carry hidden behavior into either original.
retrieval.why: The rights registry and each brief's provenance intentionally permit principles, not source reconstruction.
retrieval.possible_remediation: If a later study needs a missing principle, add a separately audited registry source rather than broadening retrieval permissions.

analysis.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
analysis.observation: The analysis records observable hierarchy, whitespace, alternating media/copy rhythm and surface-attached interaction, while hidden source choreography remains unobserved.
analysis.quality_loss: Unobserved implementation nuance cannot be measured as output fidelity and remains an explicit uncertainty.
analysis.why: DOM and capture evidence cannot establish source behavior that was not observed or legally retrieved.
analysis.possible_remediation: Limit later remediation to observable capture checkpoints and human feedback; do not infer hidden choreography from pixels alone.

planning.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
planning.observation: V1's approved brief changes the spatial system to a coordinate rail and plotted field-note panels; V2's approved brief changes it to a timecode rail and horizontal transmission bands.
planning.quality_loss: The original candidates intentionally lose V0's exact paper-collage geometry in order to test transferable principles rather than produce a derivative.
planning.why: Originality plans explicitly require substantive composition differences after human V0 approval.
planning.possible_remediation: Use the final human comparison to select which original planning principle is worth carrying forward; do not collapse the candidates back into V0 geometry.

typography.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
typography.observation: V0, V1 and V2 all use system-only type stacks; V1 changes the role pairing to a wide sans with numeric coordinate interruptions and a smaller annotation serif.
typography.quality_loss: Licensed/reference font metrics and exact source typesetting are not retained, so line breaks and density remain approximate.
typography.why: Source fonts are prohibited and the brief calls for role-level transfer with original typesetting.
typography.possible_remediation: Tune system-stack sizes and line lengths only after human visual feedback identifies a readable, original direction.

assets.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
assets.observation: The V2 transmission fields use newly authored CSS signal bands, orbital rings and registration ticks in place of source photography or artwork.
assets.quality_loss: Material and image-specific nuance is intentionally replaced by abstract geometry; no source asset fidelity is claimed.
assets.why: The originality and rights plans prohibit source imagery, logos, illustrations, fonts and project identities.
assets.possible_remediation: If the human gate identifies an asset-role weakness, adjust authored geometry and contrast, never substitute protected source media.

composition.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
composition.observation: V1 preserves asymmetrical editorial pacing while replacing V0's centered hero/collage system with a persistent coordinate rail, plotted map and alternating field notes.
composition.quality_loss: Exact reference composition is not retained; the candidate's spatial grammar is a deliberate original interpretation.
composition.why: The V1 originality plan requires a new spatial system and the capture set records its initial, mid-scroll, signature and final states.
composition.possible_remediation: Let human comparison decide whether the coordinate rail preserves sufficient editorial tension before any further visual tuning.

depth.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
depth.observation: V2 expresses depth through offset signal layers, clipped bands and inset borders rather than V0's pale sculptural object and paper shadow treatment.
depth.quality_loss: Physical material depth is abstracted into flat broadcast-console layers; visual quality is not scored by the text-only runtime.
depth.why: V2's art direction deliberately chooses a measured signal-room material language and its design evaluation is deferred to human review.
depth.possible_remediation: Use human visual feedback to adjust layer contrast or offset only if the signal-room depth reads flat at the final gate.

motion.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
motion.observation: V1 replaces V0's circular project affordance with a tokenized latitude scan that extends a beam and resolves a project coordinate at the captured signature checkpoint.
motion.quality_loss: Source motion timing and choreography are not known; only the candidate's observable token-governed relationship is evidenced.
motion.why: The motion plan prohibits reconstructing hidden choreography and the runtime can validate tokens and capture states but not aesthetic feel.
motion.possible_remediation: If the human gate finds the scan too weak or too strong, refine only the declared token-governed states and preserve reduced-motion behavior.

interaction.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
interaction.observation: V2's transmission interaction uses a coral bracket and identity-bound afterimage title trace, while the capture matrix also records keyboard-focus-compatible controls, menu state and reduced-motion state.
interaction.quality_loss: The original interaction cannot be compared to hidden source behavior beyond the explicitly captured observable checkpoints.
interaction.why: The interaction is intentionally original and the current design evaluation has no vision receipt.
interaction.possible_remediation: Use the human gate to judge affordance clarity and tune the bracket/trace only if the evidence shows a concrete comprehension problem.

implementation.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
implementation.observation: V1 and V2 are self-contained HTML/CSS/JS artifacts with no external images, fonts, iframes or continuous animation; their technical reports and token reports are independently persisted.
implementation.quality_loss: The implementation intentionally omits source runtime dependencies and photographic richness, trading exact material fidelity for auditable original work.
implementation.why: The candidate boundary requires non-reuse, deterministic capture and reduced-motion support.
implementation.possible_remediation: Keep the implementation self-contained and make only evidence-backed refinements after the human comparison.

evaluation.label: ENGINE-INFERENCE
evaluation.observation: Objective technical and deterministic capture evidence is complete for V0, V1 and V2, while all design-quality dimensions remain explicitly uninterpreted pending human visual review.
evaluation.quality_loss: Hero tension, whitespace rhythm, material depth, motion feel, originality and mobile visual re-composition are not scored by the current runtime.
evaluation.why: The active model is text-only and the contract forbids substituting DOM/style probes or fabricated vision judgments for human approval.
evaluation.possible_remediation: Present the paired reference and V0/V1/V2 captures to a human reviewer and record the explicit taste/floor decision without preselecting a candidate.
